info.title: Prumo API
info.description: API of Prumo. The web app and the Android app are clients of this contract.

get.description: Liveness and database check. No authentication, no version prefix.

post.description: Creates a session. Web gets an HttpOnly cookie; the app gets the token in the body.

get.description: Active sessions of the current user, most recently used first.

delete.description: Revokes one of the current user's sessions (any device).

put.description: Changes the password (requires the current one) and revokes every other session.

get.description: Every record of the user (D38): `data.json`, one CSV per table and the uploaded files.
Installed modules in the user's order, with their enabled state.
Home screen data: the summary of each enabled module.

Records deleted after `since`, oldest first, with the cursor of the next sync (D41).
Kept for 180 days; an older `since` answers 410 `sync.since_too_old`.
